race.comment: STORMING HOME (13) gets the nod after having genuine excuses when a narrow fourth here two weeks ago, when held up for a fair portion of the straight. Thompson sticks third-up and gets weight relief with the rise to CL2 company. Looks the one to beat. KEEP IT REAL (2) was a barnstorming winner here three weeks ago and will be looking to repeat the dose from the same draw. Expecting him to relish the extra 200m. Can give this a big shake. PEARLS IN JUNE (7) justified her short quote at the Gold Coast last time when scoring comfortably over this trip. Has been kept fresh a month between runs and is drawn to be blending into it at the right time. MONOTONE (4) is an obvious danger after beating STORMING HOME home here last time but does concede a kilo weight swing, so will have to raise the bar again.
